title: Marriage
definition: Marriage is God's covenant design uniting one man and one woman in a lifelong relationship of faithfulness, love, companionship, and mutual service.
summary: Marriage is not merely a social contract or personal arrangement. Scripture presents marriage as God's good design for covenant faithfulness, companionship, family, holiness, and Gospel witness.
christFocus: Marriage reflects Christ's love for His Church and points beyond itself to the Gospel.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Marriage is not merely a social contract or personal arrangement. Scripture presents marriage as God's good design for covenant faithfulness, companionship, family, holiness, and Gospel witness.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, think biblically, love others rightly, and live with wisdom, humility, and hope.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your relationships, choices, service, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
